file_format.f32: binary little-endian float32, interleaved: I0 Q0 I1 Q1 ...
file_format.mem: ASCII hex, one 32-bit word per line: {Q[15:0], I[15:0]}, signed clamp to int16 (same packing as RTL s_axis_tdata)

notes: frame_start=41: first of 10 consecutive windows above threshold=40000.0 (wnd=25). peakIndexAuto=23: lag of CP/tail alignment relative to frameStart. slotStartIndex=64=peakIndexAuto+frameStart=PRE_ZEROS. fracfreqOffset≈+eps_frac=0.05 (CP autocorr phase encodes CFO).
